evidence.claim: Joyce et al. 2020 derive an independent distance of 168 pc (+27/−15 pc) and present-day mass 16.5–19 M☉ for Betelgeuse, placing it in early core helium-burning on the RSG branch.
Harper et al. 2017 report a combined radio+Hipparcos parallax solution of 4.51 ± 0.80 mas, corresponding to a nominal distance of 222 pc (+48/−34 pc).
Dolan et al. 2016 evolutionary tracks suggest a best progenitor mass estimate of 20 (+5/−3) M☉ and age 8.0–8.5 Myr for Betelgeuse.
